valve-sg90-pinch Mechanism

Posted on June 29, 2026
Tags: maxima

I recently used my maxima-lsp to write equations for a non-planar mechanism for a pinch valve competition aiming at minimal material:

Starting including the servo there are two revolute joints, one ball joint followed by sliding contact between the final bar (silver allen key standin) and a crossbar.

Freecad’s assemblies don’t support that last option. It is possible to approximate it with two ball joints and a slider. Another reason to avoid freecad in this case is freecad assemblies only give you one solution, whereas there are many solutions and if they very close together one bar might flip over. After trying maxima’s hompack which doesn’t run with GCL and is too slow with alternative common lisps. I tried bertini which segfaulted before trying HomotopyContinuation.jl. HomotopyContinuation.jl does not have a presolve, and eliminating constants (and back substituting them) in maxima made a big difference in speed (around 2x).
